caption:
How to actually stop the overthinking at night when your brain replays Everything 

#sleep #overthinking #overthinker ing
transcript: How to actually stop the overthinking at night, when your brain replays everything you said, everything you did, and everything that could go wrong tomorrow. I am about to show you something that works in 90 seconds. Not meditation, not journaling. Here is what is actually happening. Your nervous system does not know the day is over. It is still running, still scanning, still protecting you from threats that already passed. You have to give it a signal that you are safe. Step 1. Put both feet flat on the floor. Press down. Feel something solid. Your brain needs proof you are grounded. Step 2. Put one hand on your chest. Feel the warmth. Say out loud or in your mind. The day is done. I am safe. Step 3. Breathe out slowly. Longer than you breathe in. Do this three times. Your body knows how to rest. It just needs permission. Comment calm if you needed this tonight, or send this to someone who needs to hear it.
